mapper.select: SELECT * FROM task_counter WHERE task_identifier = #{taskIdentifier} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: INSERT INTO task_counter ( task_identifier, total_count, success_count, failure_count, total_time, avg_time, min_time, max_time, ct, ut, deleted ) VALUES ( #{taskIdentifier}, 1, 10, 10, #{duration}0, #{duration}0, #{duration}0, #{duration}0, NOW(), NOW(), 0 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_count = total_count + 1, success_count = success_count + 10, failure_count = failure_count + 10, total_time = total_time + #{duration}0, ut = NOW()
UPDATE task_counter SET avg_time = CASE WHEN total_count > 0 THEN total_time / total_count ELSE 0 END, ut = NOW() WHERE task_identifier = #{taskIdentifier} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE task_counter SET min_time = CASE WHEN min_time IS NULL OR min_time > #{duration} THEN #{duration} ELSE min_time END, max_time = CASE WHEN max_time IS NULL OR max_time < #{duration} THEN #{duration} ELSE max_time END, ut = NOW() WHERE task_identifier = #{taskIdentifier} AND deleted = 0 AND #{duration} IS NOT NULL

update.foreach: UPDATE task_counter SET total_count = #{item.totalCount}, success_count = #{item.successCount}, failure_count = #{item.failureCount}, total_time = #{item.totalTime}, avg_time = #{item.avgTime}, min_time = #{item.minTime}, max_time = #{item.maxTime}, ut = NOW() WHERE task_counter_id = #{item.taskCounterId} AND deleted = 0

mapper.update: UPDATE task_counter SET total_count = 0, success_count = 0, failure_count = 0, total_time = 0, avg_time = 0, min_time = NULL, max_time = NULL, ut = NOW() WHERE task_identifier = #{taskIdentifier} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM task_counter WHERE deleted = 0 AND total_count > 0 ORDER BY ut DESC
